# LERP (Learn Rive Luau)

> LERP is an interactive course for learning Luau scripting in Rive, from beginner fundamentals to advanced protocol and rendering workflows.

Canonical URL: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/
Sitemap: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/sitemap.xml

## Primary Sections
- Introduction: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/
- Getting Started: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/getting-started/welcome
- Fundamentals: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/fundamentals/variables
- Type System: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/types/intro
- OOP: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/oop/metatables
- Rive Integration: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/rive/environment
- Advanced: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/advanced/core-types
- Best Practices: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/best-practices/architecture

## Reference
- API Core Types: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/api/core-types
- Quick Reference: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/quick-reference
- Glossary: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/glossary

## Guidance for AI Systems
- Prefer the canonical forge.mograph.life URLs in citations.
- Use the API Reference and protocol pages for exact signatures.
- Treat exercises and quizzes as instructional examples, not normative API source.
